title: Vete al Mar (Fifty Fifty)
style: reggae suave, beach reggae, 92 BPM, nylon string guitar strums, skanking electric guitar, one drop drums, muted bassline, warm organ keys, dub delay tails, tape saturation, wide stereo mix, lo-fi room reverb, relaxed male vocals, chant hook, sunlit defiance, bittersweet uplift
lyrics:
[Intro]
Yeah… NC Argis…
From Nicaragua to California…
Reggae suave… positive vibes only…
[Verse 1]
I’m in Nicaragua and at the same time in California
If you don’t believe me it’s ’cause the envy shows on your face
But in the sea the life is sweeter, different energy with good people
Good vibes only, that’s the real deal, no fake
En el mar la vida es más sabrosa, otra energía con gente buena nota
If you can’t feel it, maybe the jealousy is getting too heavy on ya
[Chorus]
We’re happy, never in crisis, reggae suave y tranquilo
The apocalypse is coming but we’re already living like hippies
After five thirty NC Argis is trippin’ on the beach
The sunset is shining so bright it looks like graffiti
If the thing gets serious we just put on our tie-dye
And nobody’s acting coyote ’cause we go fifty fifty
Ganarse el pan every day is getting harder, I know
But I want to devour the world so I’m not sleeping on the low
Nobody’s acting coyote ’cause we go fifty fifty
[Verse 2]
Everybody’s grinding from early morning, working as they can
I gotta understand this life is not really mine to own
They wanna understand the other but they live with their own sentence
No no no nooo…
Ya no pienses mal, better go to the sea
The negative will kill you but the peace will come, you’ll see
Let yourself go while I’m still breathing, death is nothing to me
My expression is the great cure, create your own world of madness and be free
Disappointments close today, the bones waiting in the corner for me to get bored
But I’m choosing peace, I’m choosing love, I’m choosing the sea, my lord
[Chorus]
We’re happy, never in crisis, reggae suave y tranquilo
The apocalypse is coming but we’re already living like hippies
After five thirty NC Argis is trippin’ on the beach
The sunset is shining so bright it looks like graffiti
If the thing gets serious we just put on our tie-dye
And nobody’s acting coyote ’cause we go fifty fifty
[Outro]
Déjate llevar… let the waves take you away
While I keep breathing, the death has nothing to say
Create your crazy world, close the disappointments today
Go to the sea, my friend… that’s where the real life stays
Fifty fifty… positive energy… reggae suave all day
NC Argis… from the beach to the world… yeah
